fields.text: Song in, music video out. An LLM writes short lyrics from a one-line song idea, MiniMax Music 2.6 sings them as a 15-second track, FLUX.3 Klein paints the performer, and the Music Video Generator turns the picture plus the song into a performance video driven by the audio itself. Trim keeps the billed audio at 15 s; Soundtrack puts the original full-quality song back on the video.
An upbeat synth-pop song about a little red tin-toy robot who wakes up at sunrise and waters the flowers in a rooftop garden, singing into its watering can.

fields.system:
Write lyrics for a 15-second song section from the user's idea. Output exactly this shape and nothing else:
[Verse]
(two short lines)
[Chorus]
(two short catchy lines)
Each line at most 7 words, simple words that are easy to sing, cheerful and family-friendly. No names of real people or brands.

fields.prompt: Bright, bouncy synth-pop, 118 bpm, handclaps, chiptune arpeggios, warm analog bass, a cheerful clear lead vocal, sunny morning feel.

nodes.name: Trim to 15 s (caps the video bill)

fields.text: A small shiny red wind-up tin-toy robot with a brass wind-up key on its back, round glass eyes and riveted panels, holding a little green watering can like a microphone, standing on a tiny stage in a lush rooftop garden at sunrise, potted sunflowers and tomato vines, string lights, warm golden light, city rooftops behind, colourful stylised 3D animation look, no people, no text.

fields.prompt: Upbeat performance music video of the tin-toy robot singing and dancing on its rooftop garden stage, cutting between wide shots and close-ups on the beat, playful camera moves, sunrise light, keep the same robot in every shot, no people.
